meta.title: Git workbench
meta.description: The capsule above the composer opens a Git panel bound to the current session's workspace: branch switch and create, fetch, pull (fast-forward only), stage all, commit with an AI-drafted message, push, stash and restore, discard one change, and a two-column diff. Collapsed, it renders nothing; it never writes git config, never touches credentials, and never force-pushes.
